title: Curtain Track — one Math Engine, one to three tracks, brackets and a stack-back zone
description:
A parametric CURTAIN TRACK on the six-node spine — Geometry → Input Properties → Math Engine → Output Metrics → 2D Render + 3D Render.

DROP IT ON A SEGMENT. The plan calls for a two-layer track recessed into the cove band and stacking toward one corner; `curtain-with-math` draws the fabric and a pole, and a recessed twin track is separate hardware.

MOUNT MOVES ONE PLANE. Recessed puts the track ABOVE the mount elevation so its underside is flush with the soffit; Ceiling, Wall and Face-fix hang it below. `_onWall` additionally pushes it out by the wall offset. Two flags, and the track body itself never changes.

ONE TO THREE TRACKS IS A BROADCAST, not three cases. `(_it - (_nt - 1)/2) * _tg` centres however many tracks there are about the mount line, so a single track and a sheer-plus-blackout pair take the identical path and the pair stays centred.

THE STACK-BACK ZONE IS PLAN ONLY. It is the width the gathered curtain eats when it is open — something a plan has to show and a model must not pretend is solid, so it is drawn as a 2D row and reported as `stackAllowance`, with `drawWidth` giving what is left.

BRACKETS SPAN EVERY TRACK AT ONCE, because their extent is written from `_span`, which is derived from the track count — add a track and the brackets get wider on their own.

DIMENSIONS AT THE DEFAULTS: a 1.60 m recessed twin track at 2.972 m, 0.30 m of stack to the left leaving 1.30 m of clear draw, three brackets at 0.533 m.

WHAT THIS CANNOT DO. It is straight — a bay or a return is several tracks. No carriers, no gliders and no cording. The stack zone is an allowance you set, not a fullness calculation.

props.name: Material
props.value: anodised aluminium track, brushed brass end caps

props.name: Semantics
props.value: concealed ceiling curtain track, hidden hardware, clean soffit line

params.name: Curtain Track maths
params.expr:
_natL = length
# Host frame — node, segment or space
_e1 = hcat(1, 0)
_np = rows(P)
_isSeg = _np == 2
_isSpace = _np > 2
_edges = _isSpace ? (shift(P, -1) - P) : _e1
_edgeLen = len(_edges)
_longest = max(_edgeLen)
_spaceDir = _isSpace ? row(compress(_edges, eq(_edgeLen, _longest)), 0) : _e1
_segDir = _isSeg ? (row(P, 1) - row(P, 0)) : _e1
_dir = _isSpace ? _spaceDir : (_isSeg ? _segDir : _e1)
_dirLen = len(_dir)
_axisB = _dirLen > 0 ? normalize(_dir) : _e1
_rot = rotation * PI / 180
_crot = cos(_rot)
_srot = sin(_rot)
_bx = sub(_axisB, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_by = sub(_axisB, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_axisU = hcat(_bx * _crot - _by * _srot, _bx * _srot + _by * _crot)
_axisV = (flipSide > 0 ? -1 : 1) * perp(_axisU)
_ux = sub(_axisU, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_uy = sub(_axisU, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_vx = sub(_axisV, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_vy = sub(_axisV, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_Qu = col(P, 0) * _ux + col(P, 1) * _uy
_Qv = col(P, 0) * _vx + col(P, 1) * _vy
_hu0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qu) : 0
_hu1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qu) : 0
_hv0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qv) : 0
_hv1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qv) : 0
_hcu = (_hu0 + _hu1) / 2
_hcv = (_hv0 + _hv1) / 2
_hostL = _hu1 - _hu0
_hostW = _hv1 - _hv0
# Fit to host — one uniform scale, Max never enlarges
_availL = max(0, _hostL - 2 * margin)
_notOff = fitMode != 'Off'
_exact = fitMode == 'Exact'
_sRaw = _natL > 0 ? _availL / _natL : 1
_sFit = (_notOff && _availL > 0) ? (_exact ? _sRaw : min(1, _sRaw)) : 1
scale = max(0.15, min(5, _sFit))
_s = scale
_Ln = length * _s
_tw = trackWidth * _s
_td = trackDepth * _s
_tg = max(trackGap * _s, _tw + 0.004)
_nt = max(1, round(tracks))
_mz = mountHeight
_off = wallOffset * _s
_span = (_nt - 1) * _tg + _tw
_bodyL = _Ln
_bodyW = max(_span, _td) + _off
# Anchor — place the footprint by any of the nine box points
_anchorL = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Left-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left'
_anchorR = anchorDir == 'Top-Right' || anchorDir == 'Right-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_anchorT = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Top-Center' || anchorDir == 'Top-Right'
_anchorB = anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_ax = _anchorR - _anchorL
_ay = _anchorB - _anchorT
_hau = _hcu + _ax * max(0, _hostL / 2 - margin)
_hav = _hcv + _ay * max(0, _hostW / 2 - margin)
_cu = _hau - _ax * _bodyL / 2
_cv = _hav - _ay * _bodyW / 2
_u0 = 0 - _Ln / 2
_u1 = _Ln / 2
# Mount decides ONE thing: which side of the mount plane the track sits on, and whether it is
# pushed off a wall face. Everything else about the track is the same body.
_isCeil = mount == 'Ceiling'
_isRec = mount == 'Recessed'
_isWall = mount == 'Wall'
_isFace = mount == 'Face-fix'
_onWall = _isWall || _isFace
_tz0 = _isRec ? _mz : (_mz - _td)
_tz1 = _tz0 + _td
# A recessed track is buried in the cove band — its underside is flush with the soffit.
_vBase = _onWall ? (0 - _off) : 0
_it = arange(_nt)
_tv0 = _vBase + (_it - (_nt - 1) / 2) * _tg - _tw / 2
_tv1 = _tv0 + _tw
_one = ones(_nt, 1)
_TRK = hcat(_one * _u0, _tv0, _one * _u1, _tv0, _one * _u1, _tv1, _one * _u0, _tv1, _one * _tz0, _one * _tz1, _one)
# Brackets — evenly spaced along the run, spanning every track at once.
_nb = max(0, round(brackets))
_bw = 0.03 * _s
_bv0 = _vBase - _span / 2 - 0.006
_bv1 = _onWall ? 0.006 : (_vBase + _span / 2 + 0.006)
_bu = _u0 + (arange(_nb) + 0.5) * (_Ln / max(1, _nb)) - _bw / 2
_ob = ones(_nb, 1)
_BRKr = hcat(_bu, _ob * _bv0, _bu + _bw, _ob * _bv0, _bu + _bw, _ob * _bv1, _bu, _ob * _bv1, _ob * _tz0, _ob * (_tz1 + 0.008), _ob * 2)
_BRK = _nb > 0 ? _BRKr : zeros(0, 11)
# End caps
_cw = _tw * 1.3
_E1 = hcat(_u0 - _cw, _vBase - _span / 2, _u0, _vBase - _span / 2, _u0, _vBase + _span / 2, _u0 - _cw, _vBase + _span / 2, _tz0, _tz1, 3)
_E2 = hcat(_u1, _vBase - _span / 2, _u1 + _cw, _vBase - _span / 2, _u1 + _cw, _vBase + _span / 2, _u1, _vBase + _span / 2, _tz0, _tz1, 3)
_CAPS = endCaps > 0 ? vcat(_E1, _E2) : zeros(0, 11)
# Stack-back zone — PLAN ONLY. It is the width the gathered curtain eats when it is open, which
# is a thing a plan must show and a model must not pretend is solid.
_stL = stackSide == 'Left' || stackSide == 'Both'
_stR = stackSide == 'Right' || stackSide == 'Both'
_sw = min(stackWidth * _s, _Ln / 2)
_S1 = hcat(_u0, _vBase - _span / 2, _u0 + _sw, _vBase - _span / 2, _u0 + _sw, _vBase + _span / 2 + 0.06, _u0, _vBase + _span / 2 + 0.06, _tz0, _tz0 + 0.002, 4)
_S2 = hcat(_u1 - _sw, _vBase - _span / 2, _u1, _vBase - _span / 2, _u1, _vBase + _span / 2 + 0.06, _u1 - _sw, _vBase + _span / 2 + 0.06, _tz0, _tz0 + 0.002, 4)
_SZa = _stL ? _S1 : zeros(0, 11)
_SZb = _stR ? _S2 : zeros(0, 11)
_STACK = vcat(_SZa, _SZb)
Q = vcat(_TRK, _BRK, _CAPS, _STACK)
# Quad prism — every part is a quad swept from z0 to z1 (6 faces)
_nq = rows(Q)
_r4 = ones(4,1)
_a1 = col(Q,0)
_b1 = col(Q,1)
_a2 = col(Q,2)
_b2 = col(Q,3)
_a3 = col(Q,4)
_b3 = col(Q,5)
_a4 = col(Q,6)
_b4 = col(Q,7)
_qz0 = col(Q,8)
_qz1 = col(Q,9)
_gq = kron(col(Q,10), _r4)
_fq = kron(arange(_nq), _r4) * 6
_q0 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 0, _gq)
_q1 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 1, _gq)
_q2 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a1,_b1,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 2, _gq)
_q3 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 3, _gq)
_q4 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 4, _gq)
_q5 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 5, _gq)
_FL = vcat(_q0,_q1,_q2,_q3,_q4,_q5)
_PL = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_a2,_b2,_a3,_b3,_a4,_b4), 4*_nq, 2), kron(arange(_nq), _r4), _gq)
# Local (u,v,z) -> world, once, for every part at the same time
_U = _cu + col(_FL,0)
_V = _cv + col(_FL,1)
_W = hcat(_U * _ux + _V * _vx, _U * _uy + _V * _vy, col(_FL,2), col(_FL,3), col(_FL,4))
_nw = rows(_W)
_PU = _cu + col(_PL,0)
_PV = _cv + col(_PL,1)
_WP = hcat(_PU * _ux + _PV * _vx, _PU * _uy + _PV * _vy, col(_PL,2), col(_PL,3))
_nwp = rows(_WP)
Tracks3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 1)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Brackets3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 2)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
EndCaps3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 3)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
TracksPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 1)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
BracketsPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 2)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
StackPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 4)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
# Metrics
trackLength = _Ln
trackCount = _nt
totalTrackRun = _nt * _Ln
mountElevation = _mz
trackSoffit = _tz0
stackAllowance = _stL * _sw + _stR * _sw
drawWidth = max(0, _Ln - stackAllowance)
bracketCount = _nb
bracketSpacing = _nb > 0 ? (_Ln / _nb) : 0
projection = _onWall ? (_off + _span / 2) : (_span / 2)
recessedFlag = _isRec ? 1 : 0
